notes.empty_kg: the empty tank, 380 lb (imi-600; its non-jettisonable pylon, 293 lb, is the jet's): it loads the jet as the 370's; FlightGear's F-16 gives the tank with its pylon 675 lb (fg-f16-pylons), within 2 lb of the sum
notes.drag: carriage drag index (10^4 x the drag coefficient on the F-16's 300 sq ft wing, flight-model.md §9.18): 0.15 x its 0.828 m across (imi-600) frontal area, 0.15 the drag of a streamlined tank on its pylon on that area (inferred); the F-16 manual's published indices were not at hand
notes.name: the fuel it holds in pounds, as the 370's: a name with LB is a tank (stores.rs is_tank)
notes.kg: the fuel of a full tank: 600 US gal (2271 l) of JP-8 at 0.80 kg/l (inferred density), 1817 kg (4006 lb); the tank's own 380 lb (172 kg) is its empty_kg
notes.model: our 600 US gal tank (shared/extra/models/stores/f16ftk600.glb: FlightGear's 600G.ac, 5.736 m by 0.830 m, scaled to the real 6.058 m by 0.828 m), hung by its top on the pylon (stores.gd LUGGED)
notes.fit: on 4 / 6 (f16i.glb, gear down): 3.29 m ahead of the lug to 2.77 m behind it, its bottom 0.52 m above the wheels' bottom, 5 cm from the main gear's leg (the 370: 15 cm), clear of the flaperons (0.2 m below their trailing edge at 20 degrees down) and of the stabilators (0.4 m ahead); against the photos of commons-407 and commons-803 the nose sits under the intake, ahead of the main wheels, as there
notes.size: 238.5 in (6.058 m) long, 32.6 in (0.828 m) high and wide (imi-600): a check by volume: a 0.828 m cylinder 70 % of its length holds 603 US gal, and the same 70 % of the 370's 5.56 m by 0.673 m 366 US gal (inferred); the model is 0.974 m across FlightGear's tail fins, which IMI's 32.6 in width leaves out or does not have (open)
notes.generation: ours: the weapons.ibx section key (generation · 1000 + type) is one per weapon of a kind
